title: Alianzas y conflictos
goal: Read why the conquest was fought mostly by indigenous soldiers, meet the woman whose translation made it possible, and learn what one ally negotiated for centuries afterward.

items: Explain why the conquest looks impossible if you count only Spanish soldiers.
Describe who La Malinche was and why she mattered to Cortés.
Explain the two very different ways her legacy is viewed today.
Describe the privilege Tlaxcala negotiated after Tenochtitlan fell.
Use an opening gerund to describe the method or condition behind an action.
